review.notes: The goat `s.cost` is byte-equivalent to `Cost.SelfDiscardToGrave` (utility.lua:1473-1477: same `IsDiscardable`/`IsAbleToGraveAsCost` pair, same `SendtoGrave` with REASON_DISCARD|REASON_COST), and `LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_ONFIELD+LOCATION_GRAVE` vs `|` is constant style. The Fusion-substitute effect (EFFECT_FUSION_SUBSTITUTE with the same `s.subcon` location test) is identical in both scripts, so the later text clauses - "whose name is specifically listed on the Fusion Monster Card" (v4, FUEN-EN040, 2017-02-23) and "This card in your hand, field, or GY" (v5, OP20-EN014, 2022-10-20) - are not implemented by upstream as behavioural differences and are treated as cosmetic codification. Whole lineage v1 -> v5 recorded as cosmetic; v0 (AST-082, 2004-06-01) predates the baseline and is not recorded. Verification-half bounds: old attested through 2011-02-02, modern from 2019-04-03.

event.historical_text: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s). Discard this card from your hand to the Graveyard to add a "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. The Deck is then shuffled.
event.summary: Period ruling package. Activation condition: the modern `s.target` gates the Ignition effect on `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil)` - a "Polymerization" actually in the Deck - while the goat target is `if chk==0 then return true end`, so you may discard King of the Swamp with none left, losing the card for nothing. Failed-search verification: the goat operation adds `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)` to prove the whiff. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so the transition is recorded unresolved.
